abilitywar.skill.void.skill1.desc: A void tendril drags the target in, then lands a critical punch. Slows for 1s and concusses (blurred vision).
abilitywar.skill.void.skill2.desc: Charge the void in your fist and release it: heavy damage and sends enemies flying. Concussion.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill3.desc: Teleport to the target, throw 4 punches and slam them into the ground. If the target is 3+ blocks above ground, slam immediately for the same damage.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill4.desc: Counter stance. If hit by an attack or skill (not ultimates), negate it, punch the attacker in the face and slam them down. On failure only the guard motion plays.
abilitywar.skill.void.ultimate.desc: Usable when the gauge is full. Summons a black hole that pulls everything in. Captured enemies lose 75% of max health. Players within 10 blocks see the cinematic.
abilitywar.skill.void.passive.desc: Sink into your shadow (invulnerable) and emerge from any shadow you choose: a dark spot or another creature's shadow. Press T again to emerge at the aimed shadow.

ability.abilitywar.dragon.desc: Heir of the Elder Dragon. A melee combo fighter of claws, wings and tail (hard).
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill1.desc: Dash forward and claw twice. The last hit pulls the enemy in front of you and leaves a Dragon Blood mark. Airborne enemies are slashed upward; marked enemies take an empowered last hit.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill2.desc: Spread giant wings to push nearby enemies away, then strike ahead to launch them high. Right after Dragon Claw the wings strike twice. Airborne enemies are pulled in front of you.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill3.desc: Close in instantly: right claw, left claw, tail whip, crossed-claw downstrike. Follows airborne enemies up and slams them down. Bonus hit if Dragon Claw and Wing Strike landed in a row.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill4.desc: Scale-armor counter stance. Negates basic attacks and skills (not ultimates), claws the attacker's face and tail-slams them into the ground. Success lets Fury chain immediately. On failure only the guard pose plays.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.ultimate.desc: Use with a full Dragon Blood gauge. An elder dragon phantom roars and pulls enemies in, you leap into the sky and its breath burns the area. Bonus damage on marked enemies, brief super armor. While transformed, usable as a finisher with any remaining gauge.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.passive.desc: Hold T with a full Dragon Blood gauge. Claws, wings, scales and glowing patterns grow, fire afterimages trail your movement, basic attacks become claw strikes and some skills are empowered. Ends when the gauge runs out.
abilitywar.ult.dragon.title: 古龍降臨
abilitywar.ult.dragon.subtitle: Advent of the Elder Dragon
ability.abilitywar.blade.desc: A combo swordsman wielding a mana-infused blade, striking through teleports and afterimages.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill1.desc: Take a draw stance, focus mana, then dash through enemies with a cut that leaves violet afterimages and lightly launches them. Applies a Mana Mark. Follows airborne enemies. Empowered right after Phantom Step.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill2.desc: An upward slash that fires a crescent wave, launching enemies high; a mana rift then tears open for bonus damage. Faster right after Demonic Draw, re-launches airborne enemies, bonus damage on marked enemies.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill3.desc: Teleport around the target slashing from the right, left, behind and front, then slam down (5 hits). Follows airborne enemies and forces them down. After Draw→Breaker the final cut explodes; marked enemies take an extra cut; use Phantom Step mid-dance to keep attacking.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill4.desc: A mana guard stance. Negates basic attacks and skills (not ultimates), parries, teleports behind the attacker and launches them with a slash to the back. Success lets the Blade Dance chain immediately and restores mana. On failure only the guard motion plays.
abilitywar.skill.blade.ultimate.desc: Use with a full mana gauge. Raise the blade to absorb surrounding mana, leap into the sky with a giant sword and bring down a colossal slash; mana explosions erupt along its path. Pulls nearby enemies in, bonus damage on marked enemies, super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.blade.passive.desc: Become an afterimage and teleport where you look (or behind the aimed enemy). The blade afterimage left behind explodes shortly after. Right after Demonic Draw it goes behind that enemy, during the Blade Dance it continues the attack, and the next Demonic Draw is empowered.
abilitywar.ult.blade.title: 천지개벽
abilitywar.ult.blade.subtitle: HEAVEN SPLITTER
ability.abilitywar.blood.desc: A vampiric predator that pays with its own blood, stacking bleed on enemies and draining it back.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill1.desc: Shoot a blood thread from your fingertips into an enemy, reel yourself in and rip them with both claws (follows airborne enemies into the air). Applies 1 Bleed. Enemies with 3+ Bleed have all of it burst for bonus damage. Right after Bat Swarm the enemy is pulled too and the rip hits harder.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill2.desc: Slit your wrist (costs 2 HP) and strike the ground: three waves of blood spikes erupt forward and launch enemies high. Right after Crimson Snare they erupt right under that enemy and re-launch airborne enemies. Bonus damage per Bleed stack.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill3.desc: Lunge at an enemy like a bat, claw four times (each eats a Bleed stack for bonus damage), grab them and bite to drain health, then slam them down. Airborne enemies are driven into the ground. After Snare→Spikes the drain is doubled and the final blow explodes in blood.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill4.desc: Wrap yourself in a membrane of blood. Blocking a basic attack or skill (not ultimates) bursts the veil: spikes impale the attacker from below and their blood is drained. Success lets Sanguine Frenzy chain immediately and fills the gauge. On failure the veil dissolves.
abilitywar.skill.blood.ultimate.desc: Use with a full gauge. The sky turns red and a blood moon rises. Spread bat wings, rise up, bind up to 12 nearby enemies with blood chains and pull them in, drain them while they hang in the air, then burst them all at once. Bonus damage on bleeding enemies, super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.blood.passive.desc: Scatter into a swarm of bats and fly where you look (invulnerable), biting and bleeding enemies on the way. Right after Crimson Snare you reappear behind that enemy and your next Crimson Snare is empowered.
abilitywar.ult.blood.title: 血月滿開
abilitywar.ult.blood.subtitle: BLOOD MOON BLOOM
ability.abilitywar.cantor.desc: Buffer class. Empowers themself and teammates with hymns, binds enemies with bells and judgement light.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill1.desc: Raise the baton and bring it down to release a sound wave. Allies within 9 blocks gain Valor (+30% damage dealt, 10s); nearby enemies take damage, are pushed away and get Dissonance (-20% damage dealt). Harmony: 15s, adds Grace (healing) and stuns enemies.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill2.desc: Kneel and plant the baton to raise a dome of light (radius 5, 6s). Allies inside gain Aegis (-30% damage taken) and heal; enemies that enter are bounced out and damaged. Harmony: radius 7, 8s, double healing.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill3.desc: Point to the sky and a giant bell falls on the aimed enemy (or ahead): damage, 1s stun and Dissonance, then the bell rings and grants nearby allies Haste (move speed and cooldown recovery). Harmony: the bell rings three times, damaging each time.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill4.desc: A counter stance behind a circle of light. Blocking a basic attack or skill (not ultimates) calls down judgement light on the attacker (damage + Silence: no skills for 2.5s) and heals nearby allies with Aegis. Success makes Anthem of Valor ready, adds a note and fills the gauge.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.ultimate.desc: Use with a full gauge. Light pours from the sky; rise with wings of light and a giant halo and sing the heavenly chorus. Every ally within 16 blocks heals 50%, is cleansed and gains empowered Valor, Aegis and Haste for 15s plus Grace; enemies are struck by judgement light, silenced and get Dissonance. Super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.passive.desc: Switch the always-on aura given to allies within 7 blocks: Valor -> Aegis -> Haste. The current melody shows as the halo color and the T slot color.
abilitywar.ult.cantor.title: GLORIA
abilitywar.ult.cantor.subtitle: HEAVENLY CHORUS
